who.title: Who
paragraphs: I’m Romit Raj Sahu, a CS student in Bangalore, India. I like servers, self-hosting, the open web, and finding out what a button does by pressing it. Most of what I know started as something I broke.

I haven’t picked a lane yet. Full stack, DevOps and forward deployed engineering all sound good, so for now I build small things in each and see what sticks. This site is one of them. It took far longer than it should have.

tinkering.title: Tinkering
paragraphs: Right now I run a small home server, deploy my own things on it, and write down the parts that went wrong. The longer versions of those stories live on the blog.

contact.title: Contact
paragraphs: I’m open to internships and small freelance projects. If you have something interesting, or just want to say hi, write to me.
Email is the fastest way to reach me: {email}. There is also a resume, once I finish it.
